We need to provide values:

Neutron ~1.00866491595 u (~1.00866 amu)

Diameters: approximate radius or diameter? Usually nucleon size ~0.84 fm radius; diameter ~1.68 fm. But typical value used: proton radius ~0.841 fm; neutron radius similar but slightly larger maybe 0.86 fm. So diameter ~1.7 fm. Provide approximate.

But we can also use known experimental data: Proton charge radius ~0.8409(18) fm; Neutron mean square charge radius negative small magnitude -0.1161 fm^2 so not directly giving diameter. Use effective strong interaction range ~1 fm. We could say "neutrons have no net charge but their spatial extent comparable to protons".

Thus answer: Masses as above; Diameters roughly 1.5–1.8 fm.
